description:
Outcome: The coordinator places unallocated applicants on a strictly first-come-first-served waiting list and assigns vacancies from its head, from brief.md / First version must 2 and Rules.
Scope: Batch and individual waiting placement after initial allocation capacity is exhausted, ordering by original application timestamp plus deterministic sequence, atomic head allocation and subsequent applicant entry. Excludes: bypassing the head, returning-priority reordering, automatic offers and withdrawal workflow.
Acceptance: Original application order is preserved regardless of enqueue time: adding an earlier applicant after a later applicant puts the earlier applicant first. Initial-round priority remains enforced by T-006; after that round the queue is authoritative. Concurrent assignments cannot double-allocate a plot or household.
Behaviour: Explain empty queue, no available plot and concurrent conflicts with accessible recovery actions.
Verification: Ordering tests including reversed enqueue order, initial-to-queue transition, head-only assignment and transaction race tests. Prerequisites: T-006. Assumptions: coordinator manually assigns the available plot to the head; no automatic offer expiry or withdrawal process in version one.
title: Strict chronological waiting list
